description: XAI_API_KEY delivery: pass `XAI_API_KEY` into the sandbox through Compose.

userStories.title: Pass `XAI_API_KEY` through Compose
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `agro secret set XAI_API_KEY` to reach the sandbox environment so that the Grok Build CLI can use the key.
acceptanceCriteria: `.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` passes `XAI_API_KEY=${XAI_API_KEY:-}` in the `environment:` list of the sandbox service.
`COMPOSE_SECRET_KEYS` in `.agro/cli/src/lib/secrets.ts` holds `XAI_API_KEY`, and the parity test in `.agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/secrets.test.ts` passes.
With `--sandbox <name>`, `runSecretSet` exits 0 for `XAI_API_KEY`, and a test covers the case.
`docs/configuration.md` lists `XAI_API_KEY` among the keys that `--sandbox` accepts, and states that no container process reads `META_API_KEY` from a `.env` file.
`CHANGELOG.md` has one `### Fixed` entry under `## [Unreleased]` that links #1410.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a transcript so that the PR shows the changed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/xai-key-delivery/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the output and exit code of `printf '%s\n' dummy-not-a-secret | node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js secret set XAI_API_KEY --sandbox review-box` in a temporary `AGRO_HOME`, and that exit code is 0.

The file holds the output of `docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml config` with `XAI_API_KEY=dummy-not-a-secret` in the environment, trimmed to the `XAI_API_KEY` line, or the reason that the command cannot run.
The transcript holds no real secret value.
The story deletes each temporary directory that it creates.
